title: Keto Eastern-Style Flatbread
description: A tasty and crispy flatbread recipe suitable for a keto diet, inspired by the flavors of the Middle East.

ingredients.name: Eastern Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: mix of paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper

ingredients.name: Crunchy Chopped Herbs
ingredients.notes: optional: chopped parsley, cilantro, or dill

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
2. Cut the buttery flatbread into desired shapes or sizes.
3. Brush both sides of the flatbread with a small amount of oil.
4. Sprinkle the eastern spice mix evenly over the flatbread.
5. Grill the flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
6. Sprinkle the grilled crisp over the flatbread, followed by crunchy chopped herbs if desired.
